currentRoundInspection.scope: Five actually inspected2024 courtyard/exterior pictures plus standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke surveys or redistributed photographs;current finish unverified.

pictures.author: Kaliper1
pictures.observed: Inspected960×720 southeast exterior:grey stone-clad lower wall,white upper body and merlon parapet,six white domes in two rows with higher middle drums,four corner minarets with square bases/octagonal shafts,two projecting balconies/open upper stage and small greenish bronze caps. Separate plaza umbrellas,works,trees,lighting and city content remain host assets.

pictures.author: Kaliper1
pictures.observed: Inspected960×720 wider southeast view:long rectangular low enclosure,white six-dome prayer-hall end,four equal-form staged minarets and lower courtyard-shade framework behind. Large white parapet with repeated pointed/openwork crown over grey plinth;narrow round-topped wall lights. Current plaza construction and surrounding shade umbrellas are separate host content.

pictures.author: Kaliper1
pictures.observed: Inspected500×667 close minaret:wide square base,stepped/tapered transition into tall octagonal shaft,inset pointed ornamental fields,projecting decorated lower balcony,shorter upper decorated stage and second balcony beneath open round-arched lantern,cylindrical top and greenish metal cap. Fine carving/openwork is abstracted rather than copied.

pictures.author: Kaliper1
pictures.observed: Inspected500×667 entrance:rectangular dark glazed/timber doorway in tall grey stone piers beneath a shallow white trefoil/scalloped blind hood. Grey base cladding reaches about halfway up white wall;small round-topped lattice lights and pointed/openwork white parapet crown above. Door labels,fixtures,muqarnas and actual interior not reconstructed.

pictures.author: Kaliper1
pictures.observed: Inspected960×720 courtyard:deployed cream fabric shade strips with shallow sag span between white walls above a white pointed arcade,grey square lower piers and openwork pointed merlon crown. Taller central pointed portal/arch toward prayer hall. Actual enclosed interior beyond,carpets,people,chandeliers and fixtures excluded. Model represents the observed covered-shade state,not moving canopy machinery.
